name: WEAPON-GEAR-unread
old: return climbPastPct(skill, attacker, target, opts) + weaponGearPct(attacker, skill, opts);
note: the gear on a weapon skill buys no damage again

name: WEAPON-GEAR-the-greater-not-the-sum
old: return climbPastPct(skill, attacker, target, opts) + weaponGearPct(attacker, skill, opts);
new: return Math.max(climbPastPct(skill, attacker, target, opts), weaponGearPct(attacker, skill, opts));
note: the merged greater-of, mob's "shouldn't be picking"

name: WEAPON-GEAR-only-past-200
note: a low weapon player's gear pays nothing again
